step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture depicts a multi-region active-passive serverless setup designed for high availability and disaster recovery across two regions (Region 1 and Region 2). CloudFront serves as the global front door, using Origin Failover to point primarily to an S3 bucket hosting static website assets in Region 1, with automatic failover to a replica S3 bucket in Region 2. Below the website layer, the data and auth layers are replicated across regions: DynamoDB Global Tables provide automated multi-region replication for key-value application data; S3 Cross-Region Replication asynchronously synchronizes application objects between S3 buckets in Region 1 and Region 2; and a custom AWS solution replicates Cognito User Pool identities automatically between Region 1 and Region 2.
